tasks.title: HOH TaskList Intelligence & Autonomous Evolution (327-360)
tasks.description: Deep integration between HOH and the project's task_list.json. This subsystem allows HOH to read, reason about, evolve, prioritize, validate, and autonomously improve the very task list that defines the project. Enables self-directed task management, mutation, dependency resolution, and long-term roadmap evolution using evaluation feedback, OKF, and Helix.
tasks.details: All subtasks numbered 327.x following SKILL.md decimal subtask convention. Parent ID matches the range start (327).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify task_list.json mutations are valid, dependencies remain consistent, and autonomous evolution produces coherent next batches.

subtasks.title: 327. Implement HOH TaskList Adapter
subtasks.description: Create an adapter that lets HOH safely read and write task_list.json.
subtasks.details: Provide load/save, validation, and diff capabilities. Use the existing task structures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Adapter can load the current list, make a change, and save a valid file.

subtasks.title: 328. Implement HOH Task Selection Engine
subtasks.description: Select the best pending tasks for the current iteration based on priority, dependencies, and HOH goals.
subtasks.details: Implement scoring and selection logic. Consider dependencies, priority, and estimated effort.
subtasks.testStrategy: Selection engine returns a coherent, dependency-respecting set of tasks.

subtasks.title: 329. Implement HOH Task Evolution Engine
subtasks.description: Mutate, split, merge, or refine existing tasks based on learnings.
subtasks.details: Support common mutations: add subtasks, change priority, update details, split large tasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Engine produces valid evolved tasks that still pass task validation.

subtasks.title: 330. Build HOH Task Dependency Graph
subtasks.description: Build and maintain a graph of task dependencies for analysis and scheduling.
subtasks.details: Use petgraph or simple adjacency lists. Support cycle detection and topological sort.
subtasks.testStrategy: Graph correctly models current dependencies and detects cycles.

subtasks.title: 331. Implement HOH Task Prioritization Model
subtasks.description: Score and rank tasks using multiple signals (priority, age, impact, HOH goals).
subtasks.details: Combine static priority with dynamic signals from evaluations and OKF.
subtasks.testStrategy: Prioritization produces a stable, explainable ordering.

subtasks.title: 332. Add HOH Task Completion Tracker
subtasks.description: Track completion rates, time-to-complete, and quality signals per task.
subtasks.details: Record metrics when tasks move to done. Feed into future planning.
subtasks.testStrategy: Completion data is recorded and queryable.

subtasks.title: 333. Add HOH Task Mutation Rules
subtasks.description: Define safe, versioned rules for how tasks can be autonomously changed.
subtasks.details: Ruleset for splitting, merging, re-prioritizing, and adding details. Enforce invariants.
subtasks.testStrategy: Only valid mutations are applied; invalid ones are rejected.

subtasks.title: 334. Sync TaskList with OKF Bundles
subtasks.description: Keep task list in sync with structured knowledge (OKF).
subtasks.details: When OKF concepts change, suggest or apply corresponding task updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Changes in relevant OKF bundles are reflected in or proposed for the task list.

subtasks.title: 335. Sync TaskList with Helix Evaluations
subtasks.description: Use Helix scores to update task priorities and status.
subtasks.details: Map evaluation results back to affected tasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Evaluation feedback visibly influences task list state.

subtasks.title: 336. Add HOH Task Auto-Expansion
subtasks.description: Automatically break large tasks into well-structured subtasks.
subtasks.details: When a task is too big, generate a sensible subtask breakdown.
subtasks.testStrategy: Auto-expansion produces valid, actionable subtasks that match SKILL.md guidelines.

subtasks.title: 337. Add HOH Task Auto-Refinement
subtasks.description: Improve vague task descriptions and details using context.
subtasks.details: Use surrounding code, past work, and OKF to make tasks more specific and actionable.
subtasks.testStrategy: Refined tasks have higher-quality details and testStrategy than before.

subtasks.title: 338. Add HOH Task Auto-Pruning
subtasks.description: Identify and propose removal or deferral of obsolete or low-value tasks.
subtasks.details: Detect stale, duplicate, or superseded tasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Pruning suggestions are accurate and safe (never auto-delete without review unless configured).

subtasks.title: 339. Implement HOH TaskList Versioning
subtasks.description: Version the task list so changes can be reviewed and rolled back.
subtasks.details: Store historical versions or use git for the .zed/task_list.json file.
subtasks.testStrategy: Previous versions of the task list can be retrieved.

subtasks.title: 340. Add HOH TaskList Diff Generator
subtasks.description: Produce human- and machine-readable diffs of task list changes.
subtasks.details: Show added/removed/modified tasks and subtasks clearly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Diffs are accurate and useful for review.

subtasks.title: 341. Add HOH Task Impact Analysis
subtasks.description: Estimate the downstream impact of completing (or not completing) a task.
subtasks.details: Analyze dependency graph and historical data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Impact scores correlate with actual observed effects.

subtasks.title: 342. Add HOH Task Difficulty Estimator
subtasks.description: Estimate how hard a task will be for the current agent capabilities.
subtasks.details: Use past completion data, code complexity signals, and required skills.
subtasks.testStrategy: Estimates are directionally correct (easy/medium/hard).

subtasks.title: 343. Add HOH Task Scheduling Engine
subtasks.description: Decide optimal order and timing for tasks within and across iterations.
subtasks.details: Combine dependency order, priority, difficulty, and resource budgets.
subtasks.testStrategy: Produced schedule is feasible and respects all hard dependencies.

subtasks.title: 344. Add HOH Task Conflict Detector
subtasks.description: Detect contradictory or overlapping tasks.
subtasks.details: Flag tasks that cannot be done together or that duplicate work.
subtasks.testStrategy: Real conflicts in the list are detected.

subtasks.title: 345. Add HOH Task Semantic Analyzer
subtasks.description: Understand the meaning of tasks to enable better reasoning.
subtasks.details: Use embeddings or LLM analysis of title + description + details.
subtasks.testStrategy: Semantically similar tasks are recognized as related.

subtasks.title: 346. Add HOH Task Research Generator
subtasks.description: Generate research tasks when gaps in knowledge are detected.
subtasks.details: When the system lacks information needed to plan, create research subtasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Research tasks are created when relevant information is missing.

subtasks.title: 347. Add HOH Task Risk Assessment
subtasks.description: Assess risk (breaking changes, security, complexity) of each task.
subtasks.details: Produce risk scores and mitigation suggestions.
subtasks.testStrategy: High-risk tasks are correctly flagged with reasonable mitigations.

subtasks.title: 348. Add HOH Task Reward Model
subtasks.description: Define what 'good' task completion looks like for HOH.
subtasks.details: Model reward based on quality, speed, learning produced, and alignment.
subtasks.testStrategy: Reward model can rank completed tasks sensibly.

subtasks.title: 349. Add HOH Task Agent Assignment
subtasks.description: Assign tasks to the most suitable agent profiles or skills.
subtasks.details: Match task requirements to agent capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tasks are assigned to agents that have relevant skills.

subtasks.title: 350. Add HOH Task Progress Estimator
subtasks.description: Estimate % complete and remaining effort for in-progress tasks.
subtasks.details: Use subtask completion, code changes, and test results.
subtasks.testStrategy: Progress estimates are reasonably accurate.

subtasks.title: 351. Add HOH Task Stalling Detector
subtasks.description: Detect tasks that have been in_progress or pending for too long.
subtasks.details: Alert or auto-escalate stalled work.
subtasks.testStrategy: Stalled tasks are reliably detected.

subtasks.title: 352. Add HOH Task Recovery Planner
subtasks.description: Create recovery plans for blocked or failed tasks.
subtasks.details: Suggest new subtasks, dependency changes, or alternative approaches.
subtasks.testStrategy: Recovery plans are generated for known blocked tasks.

subtasks.title: 353. Add HOH Task Completion Validator
subtasks.description: Validate that a task marked done actually satisfies its testStrategy.
subtasks.details: Run or simulate the defined test strategy. Require evidence.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tasks that do not meet their testStrategy are rejected or flagged.

subtasks.title: 354. Add HOH Task Quality Scoring
subtasks.description: Score the quality of task definitions themselves.
subtasks.details: Rate clarity, actionability, testability, and completeness.
subtasks.testStrategy: Low-quality task definitions receive low scores and improvement suggestions.

subtasks.title: 355. Add HOH TaskList Telemetry
subtasks.description: Emit metrics about task list health and evolution.
subtasks.details: Track number of tasks, completion velocity, mutation rate, etc.
subtasks.testStrategy: Telemetry is emitted and can be consumed by dashboards.

subtasks.title: 356. Add HOH TaskList Visualizer
subtasks.description: Visual overview of the current task list state and evolution.
subtasks.details: Show dependency graph, progress, and recent mutations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visualizer renders a useful view of the task list.

subtasks.title: 357. Add HOH TaskList Exporter
subtasks.description: Export the task list to other formats (Markdown, CSV, etc.).
subtasks.details: Support multiple export targets for reporting and external tools.
subtasks.testStrategy: Exports are valid and contain expected data.

subtasks.title: 358. Add HOH TaskList Importer
subtasks.description: Import tasks from external sources.
subtasks.details: Support importing from Markdown checklists, other trackers, etc.
subtasks.testStrategy: Imported tasks become valid entries in the task list.

subtasks.title: 359. Add HOH TaskList Consistency Checker
subtasks.description: Continuously validate the task list for structural problems.
subtasks.details: Check for missing fields, circular dependencies, duplicate IDs, broken references.
subtasks.testStrategy: All current consistency problems are detected and reported.

subtasks.title: 360. Add HOH TaskList Autonomous Evolution
subtasks.description: Close the loop: allow HOH to autonomously evolve the task list over many iterations.
subtasks.details: Combine selection, mutation, validation, and improvement into a continuous self-directed process.
subtasks.testStrategy: After several simulated iterations the task list measurably improves in quality and completeness.

tasks.title: HOH Advanced Autonomy, Architecture Evolution & Self-Improvement (361-400)
tasks.description: Advanced capabilities for HOH to evolve at the architectural level, perform self-refinement, enable sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, manage knowledge (OKF), perform autonomous refactoring/debugging/testing, and optimize its own processes. These features turn HOH into a true long-term self-improving system for Grok-CLI and related components (Helix, OKF).
tasks.details: All subtasks numbered 361.x. Parent ID 361 matches the range in the title per SKILL.md clarity rules. Last subtask covers 400.
tasks.testStrategy: Architecture evolution produces measurable improvements. All autonomous refactoring and agent evolution tasks pass evaluation.

subtasks.title: 361. Implement HOH Architecture Evolution Engine
subtasks.description: Core engine that proposes and applies architectural changes.
subtasks.details: Analyze current architecture, propose refactors, generate patches for new layers or module reorganizations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Engine produces at least one non-trivial architectural proposal that passes basic validation.

subtasks.title: 362. Add HOH Self-Refinement Loop
subtasks.description: Allow HOH to improve its own code and algorithms.
subtasks.details: Meta-level changes to the HOH implementation itself.
subtasks.testStrategy: Self-refinement produces measurable improvement in a subsequent iteration.

subtasks.title: 363. Add HOH Autonomous Refactoring
subtasks.description: Perform large-scale refactoring without human intervention.
subtasks.details: Move code, rename, extract modules, improve abstractions based on detected smells.
subtasks.testStrategy: Refactoring improves measured code health metrics while keeping tests green.

subtasks.title: 364. Add HOH Autonomous Debugging
subtasks.description: Automatically find, diagnose, and fix bugs.
subtasks.details: Use failing tests + static analysis + LLM reasoning to produce fixes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Injected bugs are detected and correctly patched in simulation.

subtasks.title: 365. Add HOH Specialized Agent Profiles
subtasks.description: Define distinct agent personas (architect, debugger, researcher, tester, etc.).
subtasks.details: Each profile has different tools, prompts, success criteria, and risk tolerance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Different profiles produce measurably different behavior on the same task.

subtasks.title: 366. Add HOH Agent Skill Evolution
subtasks.description: Allow agents to acquire new skills over time.
subtasks.details: Dynamic skill loading, skill synthesis, and skill retirement.
subtasks.testStrategy: An agent can be given a new capability mid-run and use it successfully.

subtasks.title: 367. Add HOH Multi-Agent Collaboration Protocol
subtasks.description: Define how agents communicate, delegate, and synchronize.
subtasks.details: Message bus, shared state, negotiation, and handoff mechanisms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Multiple agents successfully collaborate on a task that requires more than one.

subtasks.title: 368. Add HOH Multi-Agent Simulation Mode
subtasks.description: Simulate multi-agent interactions safely.
subtasks.details: Run many agents in a sandboxed environment to predict outcomes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulation produces useful predictions that match later real runs.

subtasks.title: 369. Add HOH Long-Term Strategy Engine
subtasks.description: Maintain and evolve long-term strategic goals across many iterations.
subtasks.details: Strategic objectives, milestones, and trade-off decisions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Long-term strategy influences short-term planning coherently.

subtasks.title: 370. Add HOH Multi-Project Orchestrator
subtasks.description: Coordinate work across multiple related projects.
subtasks.details: Shared knowledge, cross-project task dependencies, and resource allocation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Orchestrator can plan work that touches more than one project.

subtasks.title: 371. Add HOH Cross-Project Knowledge Transfer
subtasks.description: Transfer learnings and patterns between projects.
subtasks.details: OKF + HOH memory mechanisms for cross-project reuse.
subtasks.testStrategy: A pattern discovered in one project is successfully applied in another.

subtasks.title: 372. Add HOH Autonomous Research Agent
subtasks.description: Agent specialized in exploring unknown areas and producing research outputs.
subtasks.details: Literature-style investigation, experiment design, and knowledge synthesis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Research agent produces usable new knowledge that is injected into OKF.

subtasks.title: 373. Add HOH Architecture Stability Monitor
subtasks.description: Detect when architecture is drifting or becoming unstable.
subtasks.details: Metrics on coupling, complexity, and change rate.
subtasks.testStrategy: Drift is detected before it becomes a major problem.

subtasks.title: 374. Add HOH Codebase Health Analyzer
subtasks.description: Continuous analysis of code quality, test coverage, technical debt.
subtasks.details: Integrate clippy, test coverage, complexity tools, and custom rules.
subtasks.testStrategy: Health report accurately reflects known issues in the codebase.

subtasks.title: 375. Add HOH Semantic Code Understanding
subtasks.description: Deep semantic understanding of the codebase for better decisions.
subtasks.details: Use embeddings, call graphs, and LLM analysis of modules.
subtasks.testStrategy: System can answer non-trivial questions about code relationships correctly.

subtasks.title: 376. Add HOH Autonomous API Evolution
subtasks.description: Evolve public APIs and internal interfaces over time.
subtasks.details: Detect usage patterns and propose better API designs.
subtasks.testStrategy: API changes are proposed with migration paths and backward-compat analysis.

subtasks.title: 377. Add HOH Risk-Based Planning
subtasks.description: Plan work while explicitly accounting for risk.
subtasks.details: Risk-adjusted prioritization and mitigation steps in every plan.
subtasks.testStrategy: High-risk work is accompanied by explicit mitigation tasks.

subtasks.title: 378. Add HOH Predictive Failure Modeling
subtasks.description: Predict which changes are likely to cause failures.
subtasks.details: Use historical data + static analysis + learned models.
subtasks.testStrategy: Predictions are better than random at forecasting failing changes.

subtasks.title: 379. Add HOH Autonomous Test Generation
subtasks.description: Generate new tests for uncovered or risky code.
subtasks.details: Property-based, example-based, and integration test synthesis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Generated tests increase coverage or catch real bugs.

subtasks.title: 380. Add HOH Regression Detection
subtasks.description:
Automatically detect r
egressions introduced by changes.
subtasks.details: Compare behavior, performance, and test results across iterations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Known regressions are detected reliably.

subtasks.title: 381. Add HOH Regression Recovery Engine
subtasks.description: Automatically create recovery plans when regressions are found.
subtasks.details: Bisect, revert, or generate compensating patches.
subtasks.testStrategy: Recovery engine produces a plan that would have fixed a known regression.

subtasks.title: 382. Add HOH Architecture Simulation
subtasks.description: Simulate the effects of proposed architectural changes before applying them.
subtasks.details: Model coupling, performance, and maintainability impacts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulation predictions are directionally correct for past changes.

subtasks.title: 383. Add HOH Autonomous Documentation Generator
subtasks.description: Keep documentation up to date with code changes.
subtasks.details: Generate and update README sections, module docs, and API docs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Documentation stays in sync with major code changes.

subtasks.title: 384. Add HOH Knowledge Compression
subtasks.description: Compress and summarize large amounts of accumulated knowledge.
subtasks.details: Distill OKF bundles and iteration history into compact, queryable forms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compressed knowledge retains critical facts while reducing size.

subtasks.title: 385. Add HOH Knowledge Expansion
subtasks.description: Expand sparse knowledge areas by targeted exploration.
subtasks.details: Identify gaps and generate research or experimentation tasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Gaps are filled over time with new, useful knowledge.

subtasks.title: 386. Add HOH Knowledge Rewriting
subtasks.description: Rewrite outdated or low-quality knowledge entries.
subtasks.details: Modernize language, correct errors, improve structure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Rewritten knowledge is higher quality and still accurate.

subtasks.title: 387. Add HOH Agent Personality Profiles
subtasks.description: Give agents distinct, evolving personalities that affect behavior.
subtasks.details:
Traits
 such as caution, creativity, thoroughness, speed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Personality differences produce consistent and useful behavioral variation.

subtasks.title: 388. Add HOH Agent Negotiation System
subtasks.description: Agents can negotiate task ownership, priorities, and trade-offs.
subtasks.details: Structured negotiation protocol with proposals and acceptance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Agents reach reasonable agreements on shared work.

subtasks.title: 389. Add HOH Autonomous Design Review
subtasks.description: Automatically review proposed designs and architectures.
subtasks.details: Check against principles, past decisions, and known pitfalls.
subtasks.testStrategy: Design reviews catch real issues that would have caused problems.

subtasks.title: 390. Add HOH Autonomous Code Review
subtasks.description: Perform high-quality code reviews on patches before they land.
subtasks.details: Style, correctness, security, performance, and maintainability review.
subtasks.testStrategy: Reviews find meaningful issues while allowing good changes to proceed.

subtasks.title: 391. Add HOH Patch Quality Scoring
subtasks.description: Score every patch on multiple quality dimensions.
subtasks.details: Correctness, cleanliness, test coverage, risk, alignment with goals.
subtasks.testStrategy: Quality scores correlate with actual post-merge outcomes.

subtasks.title: 392. Add HOH Patch Risk Scoring
subtasks.description: Explicit risk assessment for every proposed patch.
subtasks.details: Breaking change risk, security risk, performance risk, etc.
subtasks.testStrategy: High-risk patches are correctly identified.

subtasks.title: 393. Add HOH Patch Optimization
subtasks.description: Automatically improve patches before they are applied.
subtasks.details: Suggest smaller diffs, better names, more tests, etc.
subtasks.testStrategy: Optimized patches are measurably better than the originals on quality metrics.

subtasks.title: 394. Add HOH Patch Semantic Validation
subtasks.description: Ensure patches are semantically coherent with the rest of the system.
subtasks.details: Check for type safety, API contract adherence, and behavioral consistency.
subtasks.testStrategy: Invalid semantic changes are rejected or flagged.

subtasks.title: 395. Add HOH Autonomous Refactor Suggestions
subtasks.description: Propose refactorings that improve long-term health.
subtasks.details: Detect smells and generate concrete refactoring proposals.
subtasks.testStrategy: Suggestions are actionable and would improve the codebase if applied.

subtasks.title: 396. Add HOH Long-Term Memory Consolidation
subtasks.description: Periodically consolidate short-term memories into durable long-term knowledge.
subtasks.details: Summarize, abstract, and index experiences for future retrieval.
subtasks.testStrategy: Consolidated memory improves future decision quality.

subtasks.title: 397. Add HOH Multi-Agent Patch Fusion
subtasks.description: Combine patches from multiple agents into a coherent whole.
subtasks.details: Conflict detection + intelligent merging + conflict resolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Fused patches from multiple agents are valid and better than any individual patch.

subtasks.title: 398. Add HOH Multi-Agent Patch Arbitration
subtasks.description: Resolve disputes when agents produce conflicting patches.
subtasks.details: Voting, evidence-based arbitration, or escalation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Arbitration produces a clear winner or merged result.

subtasks.title: 399. Add HOH Autonomous Architecture Refactoring
subtasks.description: Execute large-scale architectural refactors autonomously.
subtasks.details: Plan, validate, apply, and verify major structural changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: A non-trivial architectural refactor is successfully executed and improves metrics.

subtasks.title: 400. Add HOH Self-Optimization Engine
subtasks.description: Allow HOH to improve its own planning, evaluation, and execution loops.
subtasks.details: Meta-optimization of HOH parameters, heuristics, and algorithms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Self-optimization produces a measurable improvement in HOH performance on a benchmark iteration.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-Refinement Engine
tasks.description: Refine HOHâ€™s own algorithms, heuristics, and decision-making strategies based on meta-evaluation.
tasks.details:
Close the meta-refinement loop.
- Take meta-evaluation output and produce targeted refinements (prompt changes, parameter tuning, new heuristics, structural changes).
- Prefer small, testable refinements with rollback capability.
- Validate refinements in simulation before promoting to production HOH.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Refinements measurably improve the metrics identified by meta-evaluation.
2. Refinement process itself is logged and reviewable.
3. Bad refinements are detected and rolled back.

tasks.title: Add HOH Future Trajectory Simulator
tasks.description: Simulate future development paths and predict long-term outcomes of architectural decisions.
tasks.details:
Long-horizon simulation.
- Run many possible futures from current state using different policy choices.
- Model second- and third-order effects.
- Produce probability distributions over key outcomes (velocity, stability, technical debt, etc.).
- Use results to inform governance and long-term strategy.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Simulator can run 10-50 step trajectories.
2. Predictions are directionally useful when compared to actual historical runs.
3. Simulator is fast enough to be used inside planning loops.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Roadmap Generator
tasks.description: Generate multi-year roadmaps based on project goals, evaluation trends, and predicted trajectories.
tasks.details:
Long-term autonomous roadmap creation.
- Synthesize goals, current state, evaluation history, and trajectory simulations into phased roadmaps.
- Include milestones, risk points, and decision branches.
- Update roadmaps automatically as reality diverges from predictions.
- Expose roadmaps in human-readable and machine-consumable forms.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. A coherent multi-phase roadmap is generated.
2. Roadmap is updated after significant events.
3. Roadmap influences near-term planning in a visible way.

tasks.title: Add HOH Cross-Domain Knowledge Fusion
tasks.description: Fuse knowledge from different domains into unified OKF bundles for improved reasoning.
tasks.details:
Knowledge fusion layer.
- Detect when knowledge in one domain (e.g. architecture) is relevant to another (e.g. testing strategy).
- Create or update unified OKF concepts that combine signals from multiple sources.
- Maintain provenance so fused knowledge can be audited or split if needed.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Fusion produces new OKF entries that are more useful than the sum of their parts.
2. Downstream reasoning improves when using fused knowledge.
3. Fusion does not create incorrect or overly confident claims.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Research Planner
tasks.description: Plan long-term research tasks to explore unknown areas or emerging technologies.
tasks.details:
Strategic research planning.
- Identify high-leverage unknown areas from trajectory simulations and knowledge gaps.
- Generate multi-iteration research programs with clear hypotheses and success criteria.
- Balance exploration vs exploitation in the overall HOH portfolio.
- Integrate results back into OKF and the main development roadmap.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Research plans are generated for identified knowledge gaps.
2. Research tasks have clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
3. Completed research measurably reduces uncertainty in subsequent planning.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Innovation Engine
tasks.description: Generate innovative features, tools, or subsystems based on gaps or opportunities detected in the project.
tasks.details:
Systematic innovation generation.
- Combine creativity engine output with opportunity detection (from metrics, user signals, technology trends).
- Produce concrete innovation proposals with rough effort estimates and expected value.
- Support staged validation (idea â†' prototype â†' experiment â†' integration).
- Track innovation success rate over time.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Engine produces innovations that are not obvious extensions of current work.
2. At least one innovation progresses through multiple validation stages.
3. Innovation pipeline metrics are tracked and improve over time.

tasks.title: Add HOH Agent Collaboration Graph
tasks.description: Model agent interactions and optimize collaboration patterns for maximum productivity.
tasks.details:
Collaboration modeling and optimization.
- Build a graph of agent-to-agent interactions, handoffs, and conflicts.
- Analyze the graph for bottlenecks, underused connections, and high-performing patterns.
- Use analysis to suggest or automatically adjust collaboration topology.
- Feed results into multi-agent protocol improvements.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Collaboration graph is built and updated during runs.
2. Analysis identifies real collaboration issues.
3. Suggested changes improve measured collaboration efficiency.

tasks.title: Add HOH Agent Personality Evolution
tasks.description: Allow agent personalities to evolve based on performance, collaboration, and evaluation feedback.
tasks.details:
Personality as an evolvable trait.
- Represent personality as a vector or set of traits with history.
- Evolve traits using the same mechanisms as other agent capabilities (405).
- Correlate personality changes with performance and collaboration outcomes.
- Support 'personality archetypes' that can be cloned or hybridized.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Personality traits evolve in response to feedback.
2. Certain personality configurations correlate with better outcomes in specific roles.
3. Evolution preserves useful personality diversity.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Creativity Scoring
tasks.description: Score creative outputs based on novelty, usefulness, and alignment with project goals.
tasks.details:
Multi-dimensional creativity evaluation.
- Novelty: distance from existing patterns (embeddings + structural diff).
- Usefulness: predicted or measured value (Helix scores, downstream adoption).
- Alignment: fit with current goals, governance, and roadmap.
- Combine into a composite creativity score used for ranking and selection.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Scoring produces consistent, explainable results.
2. High-scoring outputs are more likely to be selected for further development.
3. Scoring improves over time as more data is collected.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Experimentation Engine
tasks.description: Run controlled experiments on architecture, agents, or algorithms to discover better approaches.
tasks.details:
Scientific experimentation framework inside HOH.
- Design experiments with clear hypotheses, controls, and success metrics.
- Run experiments in simulation or isolated branches.
- Analyze results with statistical rigor appropriate to the domain.
- Promote winning variants into the main system and record them in OKF.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Experiment design is valid (clear hypothesis + metrics).
2. Results are statistically sound and reproducible.
3. Winning variants are promoted and produce measurable improvement.

tasks.title: Add HOH Hypothesis Generator
tasks.description: Generate hypotheses about system behavior, performance bottlenecks, or architectural weaknesses.
tasks.details:
Automated hypothesis generation.
- Analyze telemetry, evaluation results, code structure, and iteration history.
- Produce testable hypotheses in a structured format.
- Prioritize hypotheses by expected information gain and impact.
- Feed directly into the Experimentation Engine (422).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Generator produces hypotheses that are specific and testable.
2. Generated hypotheses cover a useful range of the system.
3. At least some hypotheses, when tested, yield actionable insights.

tasks.title: Add HOH Hypothesis Testing Engine
tasks.description: Test hypotheses using controlled experiments, simulations, and evaluation feedback.
tasks.details:
Hypothesis testing execution layer.
- Translate hypotheses into experiments or observational studies.
- Run tests (simulation, A/B, historical replay).
- Apply statistical tests and record confidence.
- Update beliefs in OKF and influence planning.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Hypotheses are tested with appropriate rigor.
2. Results include clear accept/reject/uncertain outcomes with evidence.
3. Belief updates are visible in subsequent planning.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Theory Builder
tasks.description: Build theories about system behavior, agent dynamics, and architectural evolution.
tasks.details:
Theory construction from evidence.
- Aggregate results from many experiments and observations.
- Synthesize higher-level explanatory models.
- Represent theories in a machine-readable + human-readable form (in OKF).
- Use theories to guide future hypothesis generation and planning (strong priors).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Coherent theories are constructed from raw data.
2. Theories make non-trivial, testable predictions that hold up.
3. Use of
 theories improves planning quality over time.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Concept Discovery
tasks.description: Discover new concepts, abstractions, or patterns within the codebase or architecture.
tasks.details:
Concept discovery system.
- Analyze code, patches, evaluations, and agent behavior for recurring or emerging abstractions.
- Propose new named concepts with definitions and examples.
- Add discovered concepts to OKF with provenance.
- Use new concepts in future reasoning and code generation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meaningful new concepts are discovered and named.
2. Concepts are useful in downstream tasks (planning, explanation, generation).
3. Concept quality improves with more data.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Pattern Mining
tasks.description: Mine recurring patterns from patches, evaluations, and agent behavior.
tasks.details:
Pattern mining pipeline.
- Extract structural, behavioral, and process patterns from the full history of HOH activity.
- Cluster similar patterns and identify high-value ones.
- Represent patterns in a form usable by the Pattern Application and Evolution engines.
- Track pattern usage and success rate.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Recurring high-value patterns are automatically identified.
2. Patterns have clear applicability conditions.
3. Mining improves over time as more history accumulates.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Pattern Application
tasks.description: Apply discovered patterns to improve architecture, code quality, or agent performance.
tasks.details:
Pattern application engine.
- Match current situation against known good patterns.
- Generate concrete applications (refactors, prompt changes, process adjustments).
- Validate applications before wide use.
- Measure lift from pattern application.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Patterns are successfully applied to new situations.
2. Applied patterns produce measurable improvement.
3. Inappropriate pattern applications are rejected.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Pattern Evolution
tasks.description: Evolve patterns over time as the system grows and new requirements emerge.
tasks.details:
Pattern evolution.
- Treat patterns as evolvable artifacts (similar to agents and strategies).
- Combine, specialize, generalize, and retire patterns based on usage data and outcomes.
- Maintain a living pattern library with version history and success metrics.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. High-value patterns evolve and improve.
2. Low-value or outdated patterns are deprecated.
3. The pattern library grows in both quantity and quality.

tasks.title: Add HOH Agent Ecology Simulator
tasks.description: Simulate agent ecosystems to predict emergent behavior and optimize collaboration.
tasks.details:
Agent population simulation.
- Model populations of agents with different profiles interacting over time.
- Predict emergent phenomena (specialization, dominance, collaboration breakdowns).
- Use simulation results to tune ecosystem parameters before applying them to reality.
- Support 'what-if' experiments on ecosystem composition.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Simulation produces plausible emergent behaviors.
2. Simulation predictions correlate with real multi-agent run outcomes.
3. Simulation is used to improve real ecosystem configuration.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Domain Expansion
tasks.description: Expand HOH into new domains such as UI design, DevOps, documentation, or research.
tasks.details:
Domain expansion framework.
- Detect when a new domain would be high-value.
- Bootstrap minimal capability in the new domain (tools, knowledge, agent profiles).
- Gradually increase autonomy in the new domain while maintaining safety.
- Integrate new domain knowledge into the broader HOH system.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. At least one new domain is successfully bootstrapped.
2. Work in the new domain produces useful output.
3. Expansion does not destabilize existing domains.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Tool Creation
tasks.description: Allow HOH to design and implement new tools when existing ones are insufficient.
tasks.details:
Autonomous tool synthesis.
- Identify tool gaps from failed tasks or repeated workarounds.
- Design new tool interfaces and implementations.
- Generate, test, and integrate the new tool into the tool registry.
- Deprecate or evolve tools via the companion retirement/evolution tasks.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. A genuinely useful new tool is created and integrated.
2. The new tool is used successfully by agents in subsequent work.
3. Tool creation follows safety and review processes.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Tool Retirement
tasks.description: Retire tools that are obsolete, redundant, or underperforming.
tasks.details:
Tool lifecycle management (retirement side).
- Detect low-usage, superseded, or harmful tools.
- Safely remove or deprecate tools while updating dependent prompts and agents.
- Archive tool history and rationale.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Obsolete tools are correctly identified.
2. Retirement does not break legitimate ongoing work.
3. Dependent agents and plans are updated.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Tool Evolution
tasks.description: Evolve tools based on usage patterns, evaluation feedback, and emerging needs.
tasks.details:
Continuous tool improvement.
- Collect usage telemetry and outcome data per tool.
- Propose and apply improvements (new parameters, better error handling, performance, new capabilities).
- Version tools and support gradual rollout.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Tool evolution produces measurable improvements in success rate or efficiency.
2. Evolution is driven by real usage data.
3. Tool versions are properly tracked.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Workflow Optimization
tasks.description: Optimize workflows across agents, tools, and tasks for maximum efficiency.
tasks.details:
End-to-end workflow optimization.
- Model current workflows (sequences of agent + tool usage).
- Identify bottlenecks, redundant steps, and low-value work.
- Propose and validate improved workflows.
- Automatically adopt high-confidence improvements.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Workflow bottlenecks are correctly identified.
2. Optimized workflows show clear efficiency or quality gains.
3. Optimization is applied safely with rollback.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Strategy Mutation
tasks.description: Mutate long-term strategies when HOH detects stagnation or new opportunities.
tasks.details:
Strategy mutation system.
- Monitor strategy effectiveness over time.
- When stagnation or new opportunities are detected, generate strategic mutations.
- Test mutations in simulation before promoting.
- Maintain a portfolio of active and experimental strategies.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Strategy mutations are generated in response to real signals.
2. Successful mutations improve long-term metrics.
3. Failed mutations are retired cleanly.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Strategy Fusion
tasks.description: Fuse multiple strategies into unified plans for complex multi-domain projects.
tasks.details:
Strategy combination.
- Detect when multiple strategies are relevant to the same goal.
- Intelligently combine them (sequencing, parallel execution, conditional branching).
- Resolve conflicts between strategies.
- Produce coherent unified execution plans.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Fusion produces plans that are better than using any single strategy alone.
2. Conflicts between strategies are resolved explicitly.
3. Fused plans execute successfully.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Strategy Evolution
tasks.description: Evolve strategies over time based on performance, evaluation, and trajectory predictions.
tasks.details:
Long-term strategy evolution.
- Treat strategies as evolvable artifacts with fitness based on real outcomes.
- Combine successful elements from multiple strategies.
- Retire or de-emphasize underperforming strategies.
- Use trajectory simulation to evaluate potential strategy changes before committing.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Strategy portfolio evolves toward higher-performing strategies.
2. Evolution is driven by evidence.
3. The system maintains strategic diversity when appropriate.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Meta-Agent
tasks.description: Create a meta-agent responsible for overseeing HOH itself and coordinating self-improvement.
tasks.details:
Meta-agent implementation.
- A special high-privilege agent whose sole job is to improve HOH.
- Has privileged access to HOH internals, logs, and configuration.
- Operates under very strong governance and safety constraints.
- Can spawn temporary sub-agents for specific meta-tasks.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-agent is created and can observe HOH internals.
2. Meta-agent successfully proposes and drives at least one self-improvement.
3. Meta-agent actions are heavily logged and auditable.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-Agent Reasoning Engine
tasks.description: Enable the meta-agent to reason about HOHâ€™s architecture, agents, and long-term goals.
tasks.details:
Specialized reasoning for the meta-agent.
- Deep models of HOH's own components and dynamics.
- Ability to simulate 'HOH improving HOH' at multiple levels of recursion.
- Strong focus on second-order effects and stability.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-agent produces high-quality reasoning about HOH internals.
2. Reasoning leads to proposals that are accepted by governance.
3. Recursive reasoning does not cause instability.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-Agent Planning Engine
tasks.description: Allow the meta-agent to generate plans for improving HOHâ€™s internal systems.
tasks.details:
Meta-level planning.
- Plans that target HOH components (planner, memory, evaluation, agents, etc.).
- Heavy use of simulation and risk assessment.
- Explicit consideration of meta-risk (risk of the improvement process itself).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-plans are generated for real HOH improvement opportunities.
2. Plans include strong validation and rollback steps.
3. At least one meta-plan is successfully executed.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-Agent Evaluation Engine
tasks.description: Evaluate the performance of HOHâ€™s subsystems and generate improvement tasks.
tasks.details:
Meta-evaluation specialized for HOH internals.
- Detailed instrumentation and analysis of every HOH component.
- Generate specific, actionable improvement tasks (not just high-level observations).
- Track the 'improvement of the improvement process' over time.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-evaluation identifies specific, fixable weaknesses in HOH.
2. Generated tasks are accepted into the task list and completed.
3. HOH performance improves as a result.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-Agent Evolution Engine
tasks.description: Allow the meta-agent to evolve its own reasoning, heuristics, and strategies.
tasks.details:
Meta-agent self-evolution.
- The meta-agent can apply the same evolution mechanisms it uses on other agents to itself (with extra caution).
- Focus on improving meta-reasoning quality, planning horizon, and safety judgment.
- Extremely conservative promotion of changes to the meta-agent.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-agent evolves in ways that improve its own effectiveness.
2. Self-evolution is slower and more heavily validated than regular agent evolution.
3. Evolution history of the meta-agent is especially well documented.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Future Simulation Engine
tasks.description: Simulate future states of the project, agents, and architecture to guide long-term planning.
tasks.details:
Comprehensive future simulation.
- Simulate project state, agent populations, knowledge base, and architecture under different policy choices.
- Support multi-year horizons with appropriate abstraction.
- Produce scenario trees and key decision points.
- Directly feed the Roadmap Generator and Strategy engines.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Multi-step future simulations run successfully.
2. Simulated futures are useful for distinguishing good vs bad long-term decisions.
3. Simulation is regularly used in real planning.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Creativity Ecosystem
tasks.description: Create an ecosystem where agents collaborate to generate creative solutions and innovations.
tasks.details:
Creativity as an ecosystem property.
- Multiple agents with different creativity profiles work together on idea generation.
- Structured collaboration patterns (brainstorming, critique, combination, selection).
- Ideas are evolved, combined, and stress-tested inside the ecosystem before being promoted.
- Measure and optimize the 'creative output' of the entire ecosystem.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. The ecosystem produces higher-quality and more diverse ideas than individual agents alone.
2. Collaboration patterns for creativity are effective.
3. Ecosystem creativity metrics trend upward over time.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Innovation Scoring
tasks.description: Score innovations based on novelty, feasibility, and alignment with long-term goals.
tasks.details:
Innovation-specific scoring.
- Extend creativity scoring with long-term value, platform potential, and strategic fit.
- Include expected cost, time-to-value, and risk.
- Use scores to prioritize which innovations receive resources for prototyping and integration.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Scoring correctly ranks innovations by overall value.
2. High-scoring innovations are more likely to be pursued and succeed.
3. Scoring model improves with more innovation outcomes data.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Innovation Evolution
tasks.description: Evolve innovations over time as new insights and evaluation feedback emerge.
tasks.details:
Innovation maturation.
- Treat promising innovations as living artifacts that can be refined, combined, or pivoted.
- Use evaluation feedback from prototypes and experiments to evolve the innovation concept itself.
- Maintain an innovation portfolio with stages (idea, validated, prototype, integrated, mature).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Innovations evolve from raw ideas into higher-maturity forms.
2. Evolution is driven by real evidence.
3. The portfolio shows a healthy pipeline of innovations at different stages.

tasks.title: Add HOH Autonomous Innovation Fusion
tasks.description: Fuse multiple innovations into unified architectural or system-level improvements.
tasks.details:
Innovation combination at scale.
- Identify complementary or synergistic innovations.
- Design fused solutions that are greater than the sum of parts.
- Handle the increased complexity and risk of fused innovations.
- Produce integrated implementation plans.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Fusion produces innovations that are clearly superior to applying the parts separately.
2. Fused innovations are successfully implemented.
3. Fusion process manages complexity appropriately.

tasks.title: Add HOH Meta-HOH Layer
tasks.description: Implement a higher-order HOH layer that oversees and improves the primary HOH system, enabling recursive self-improvement.
tasks.details:
The Meta-HOH (HOH-of-HOH) layer.
- A higher-order outer loop that treats the primary HOH as its 'inner harness'.
- Responsible for long-term evolution of HOH's own architecture, governance, evaluation, and improvement processes.
- Operates on even longer timescales and with even stronger safety constraints.
- This is the ultimate recursive self-improvement mechanism described in the HOH vision.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Meta-HOH layer is implemented as a distinct (but related) system to primary HOH.
2. Meta-HOH can observe, evaluate, and propose changes to primary HOH.
3. At least one improvement originating from Meta-HOH is successfully applied to primary HOH.
4. The recursive structure remains stable and auditable.
